steps.en: Create the calendar over your events, resources and a timezone
steps.zh: 用你的事件、资源和时区创建日历

steps.en: Builds the day grid for the period and expands recurring events into occurrences
steps.zh: 为当前周期构建日期网格，把重复事件展开成单次出现

steps.en: Serve events for the visible range from your own API or store
steps.zh: 从自己的接口或存储返回可见范围内的事件

steps.en: Loads only the required range and vetoes moves that break availability or capacity
steps.zh: 只拉取需要的范围，并否决违反可用性或容量规则的移动

steps.en: Render days and events as your own markup and wire the resize handles
steps.zh: 用自己的标记渲染日期与事件，接上拖拽调整的手柄

steps.en: Recomputes projections and journals undo entries on every edit
steps.zh: 每次编辑后重算投影并记录撤销日志

value.en: Recurrence expansion, DST-safe grids, conflict vetoes and undo without writing any of it — and zero imposed DOM (today: vendored from a pre-alpha branch)
value.zh: 重复展开、夏令时安全网格、冲突否决、撤销都不用自己写，DOM 全归你（今天需从 pre-alpha 分支引源码）
